pages.text: The Divine Heavenly Dao has $(l)30,000 health$(), 100 armor, 30 toughness and 100 base attack damage. Its collision body can break blocks, and oppressive music plays while it lives. It is $(l)immune to all ranged attacks$() and enrages nearby Endermen.$(br2)Its attacks have a wind-up:

$(li)$(l)Earthshaker$(): a ring of sparks marks the ground, then it smashes down. Entities standing on the ground take 100 damage and are thrown 20 blocks up, so $(l)jump$() at the right moment.$(li)$(l)Heavenly Thunder$(): 36 bolts over 10 seconds, 150 damage each. $(l)One of them always strikes you$() (only once, and armor still applies); the rest strike nearby creatures.$(li)$(l)Heaven's Strike$(): a charged direct blow for 150 damage.

$(l)Abyss$(): the orb flies at 5 blocks/tick, explodes with power 100 and a 500-block effect radius. Within the 180-block damage radius, damage falls from 700 at the center to 200 at the edge. When you see the hands go up, $(l)run$() or get behind thick cover. It is not hurt by its own blast.
At low health it enters $(l)phase two$(): it heals every second, attacks faster and summons 3 dragon-sized $(l)Giant Withers$(). While they live the Boss takes half damage, so clear them first.
Drops 4-8 Heavenly Dao Fragments, Enchanted Golden Apples and Nether Stars; it no longer drops a Dragon Egg. Fragments craft the S-tier gear.
